Our procurement team prefers invoice-only setup for the first 90 days rather than issuing POs immediately. Hi Sana  thanks for the details and the onboarding form. Were supportive of getting the pilot started quickly. A couple of items procurement needs before we can grant a temporary invoice-only pathway:

- Completed W-9 on company letterhead (or PDF)
- Remit address + ACH details (or confirmation they will invoice with wire instructions)
- Max monthly cap youre comfortable with (you mentioned ~$1.2k first month, is $2k firm?)
- Confirmation you accept Redwoods standard trial terms (Ive attached the onboarding form link again)

Ill kick this to Procurement (ccd) for an exception request. If Procurement signs off, Legal will do a quick check on terms redlines and we can create a temporary vendor record.

Kimberly / Marissa,

Thanks for flagging. I reviewed TinySpends submissions. W-9 and AP details are complete. TinySpend_terms_redlines.docx contains a single indemnity adjustment; Legal noted wording is acceptable if we limit the pilot exposure.

Procurement is fine to approve a 90-day invoice-only exception under the following conditions:
- Maximum monthly cap: $2,000
- Exception duration: 90 days from vendor activation date
- Finance to mark invoices with "TEMP-INVOICE-PILOT - TinySpend Labs" memo for tracking
- Vendor to provide PO within 10 business days prior to exception expiry or procurement will halt services
- Evidence to be stored in vendor record (W-9, AP details, signed acceptance of pilot terms)

Please confirm approval from Revenue Ops for billing workflow and Legal sign-off on the redline acceptance. Ive opened Jira POEX-412 to track the exception and assigned to our onboarding queue.

Thanks,
Priyom Das
Vendor Operations (Procurement)
